title: Tax season
summary: 1099s out in January, Delaware franchise tax by March 1, the R&D credit claimed, the 1120 filed.

parts.title: Issue 1099s
parts.guidance: Identify the reporting year and payees from reconciled payments and current tax documentation. Use the information-return workflow to have the tax owner confirm which forms and reporting rules apply before preparation. Review recipient details and amounts, use the applicable filing authorization, and track the due date, submission and recipient delivery for each required return.

parts.title: File DE franchise tax
parts.guidance: Confirm the Delaware entity type, reporting year and current corporate information before entering the franchise-tax workflow. Assemble the relevant share and financial records for the preparer, and have the responsible tax owner review the calculation and filing requirements. Retain the approved submission and payment confirmation, with any state response or outstanding issue tracked separately.

parts.title: Claim the R&D tax credit
parts.guidance: Gather project activities, costs and supporting records for the tax year before evaluating a research credit. Follow the credit workflow with a qualified tax reviewer to determine eligibility, allocation and the applicable claiming route from the actual facts. Keep the reviewed calculation and evidence with the return package, distinguishing a potential opportunity from a claim approved for filing.

parts.title: File federal tax return
parts.guidance: Prepare the federal return from the reviewed books, entity classification, tax-year records and other applicable schedules. Use the return workflow to reconcile adjustments and related claims with the preparer before an authorized signer approves submission. Preserve the filed return, acceptance evidence and payment or follow-up records, avoiding the assumption that every company in this catalog files the same form.
